svg.aria-label: Simulated matrix suppression weakens as the sample is diluted; the true original concentration is 800 pg/mL. Orange bars show the sample SD of three technical wells. The right panel compares an unspiked sample at 40 pg/mL, the expected spiked value of 65 pg/mL and the measured value of 62 pg/mL.
